UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended — sign in again
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts — wait a few minutes
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server
SESSION_EXPIRED: Time is up or there were too many attempts — start over
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Too much data for a single request
DEVICE_REVOKED: This device was revoked — sign in again
WRONG_REGION: Your account is served by another server — try again
RECOVERY_INVALID: Username or Recovery Key doesn’t match
RECOVERY_KEY_FORMAT: This doesn’t look like a Recovery Key: it starts with ILRK1 followed by 34 characters
RECOVERY_KEY_CHECKSUM: There’s a typo in the key — the checksum doesn’t match. Check the characters
DECRYPT_FAILED: Couldn’t decrypt the data: the key doesn’t fit or the data is damaged
KDF_FAILED: Couldn’t derive a key from the password: the browser ran out of memory or blocks WebAssembly
VAULT_UNAVAILABLE: Storage on this device is unavailable (private mode or site data is blocked)
VAULT_LOCKED: The vault is locked — reload the page
ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The session in this browser belongs to another account — sign in again
KDF_LIMIT: The server sent password protection settings that are too heavy — sign-in stopped to protect your browser
VAULT_CHANGED: The vault was changed in another tab — reload the page
